adjudication.rationale: In `SalesforceCalendarService` a refresh-token POST to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` plus `prisma.credential.update(...)` is now executed unconditionally during service construction (no expiry check/guard), so every instantiation performs an outbound call and DB write on the hot path.
